overallReport.summary: Riley performs best on average and appears to be the preferred host, consistently leading in both average views and average public likes. In contrast, Linus records the weakest results for both average views and average public likes. While Riley also leads in total views and total likes, this is heavily influenced by a significantly higher upload volume compared to the other hosts. Elijah and Linus have much smaller sample sizes, which makes their specific rankings less reliable than those of Riley and James. James holds the second-highest total views and likes, reflecting his higher upload count relative to the newer hosts.
